records.question: A water tank has a capacity of 4000 gallons. Mack connects a pipe to the tank that fills the tank with water at the rate of 10 gallons per hour. How long will it take to fill the tank to 3/4 of its capacity?
records.response:
3/4 of the capacity of the water tank is 3/4 * 4000 = 3000 gallons.
Since the pipe fills the tank at the rate of 10 gallons per hour, it will take 3000/10 = 300 hours to fill the tank to 3/4 of its capacity.
#### 300
